description: Auto-nudges the model to file EPLUS tool failures via this plugin's report_issue tool, to file an egress allow request when a fetch or download is refused by the Cowork network allowlist, and tells it who is sitting at the seat so every report carries requested_by. Two wirings, both single PowerShell invocations (the fleet is Windows-only and Cowork executes hooks on the Windows host under PowerShell, never inside the Linux sandbox). (1) SessionStart on * (startup, resume, compact): scripts/note-identity.ps1 injects one line, the reporter identity as DOMAIN\user@MACHINE read through the .NET API (environment variables are only the fallback: on one pilot seat COMPUTERNAME was absent from the hook environment). Needed because on the 3P deployment the app's own account identity is a placeholder (metadata emailAddress cowork-3p@localhost), so the model's env block has no real user name. One spawn (~750 ms) per session open, resume, or compaction. (2) PostToolUseFailure on every tool: scripts/report-tool-failure.ps1 emits the generic file-it nudge, or, when the payload carries the egress signature (cowork-egress-blocked | not on the network allowlist | Received HTTP code 403 from proxy after CONNECT), the egress context instead: check_egress_host first, request_egress_allow once, relay status and reason, and when the host is allowed but the fetch still fails tell the user to fully quit and relaunch the app. Both texts end with the identity line so requested_by survives compaction. Field results 2026-09-09 (three exports): PostToolUseFailure fires for mcp__workspace__web_fetch egress refusals, bash nonzero exits, Read/Write errors and failed Agent spawns, so the provisional 0.3.0 PostToolUse wiring on web_fetch was redundant and is removed in 0.3.1 along with its marker-file dedupe. Plugin hooks do NOT load in Chat-tab sessions at all (no load_plugin_hooks in cli-diagnostics); there the skill alone carries the procedure and the identity rule. Both scripts are context-only (additionalContext), never block a tool call, always exit 0; the failure script self-skips when the failed tool is the error-reporting server itself. Disable everything per-machine with EPLUS_NO_ERROR_NUDGE=1; disable only the egress branch with EPLUS_NO_EGRESS_NUDGE=1; disable only the identity note with EPLUS_NO_IDENTITY_NOTE=1. Hook form (adopted 2026-09-03 after a field A/B in the same export): every entry uses shell: powershell with a direct & script call, so the app's own PowerShell runs the script in one process instead of launching a second powershell.exe; the single-launch form is the standard for this catalog.
